GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went thrtough on fence to lead. led turn. swamped late # Every Chance
Jumped Ok sat rail 4l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 4l off, worked home well making good ground late # hit line well
Jumped Well held rail half off, improved turn, Straightened Up joint lead, headed approaching 200m and dropped out # weak run home

Jumped evenly. Niggled early & raced 5th Two Wide (2.5L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & outsprinted in last 150m. # Every Chance
(norton bit off) Jumped Fast Wide out. camped 3 Wide No Cover 3rd 1 length @ 700m. same to straightening up Just Outside winner , peaked then Gradually Gave Ground # on-pace 3w/faded

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped ok. Went Forward and Settled Down close 3rd 3 Wide Outside Leader over-racing b/t horses. Straightened Up 4th under riding and Wide there. Beaten quickly and dropped out. # pace/wide/weak
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled wide and without cover throughout the event. Whilst weakening near the 200m, was steadied when crowded for room. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Improved Outside Leader a neck. joined Leader to Turn . Straightened Up chasing, Battled On Well in 2 Horse War . Took over 100m Under Whip only to be swamped near line # on speed/game
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jockey reported that his mount was inclined to lay out approaching and rounding the home turn, however, after balancing up in the home straight, the filly was inclined to lay inwards. He added that, he was of the opinion, the filly may not appreciate the Norton Bit, which is a part of its official race gear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 2 Lengths when blundered. Settled Down 8th Two Wide 7 L. eased Wide Inside 800m and Straightened Up 8th under riding well off rail. failed to improve. vetted normal/run queried and rider said # tardy/didn't travel
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: rdr reported he anticipated his mount settling prominently, however, after blundering at the start, the filly settled towards the rear of the field. He stated that his mount did not travel comfortably in this position throughout the early and middle stages, with it inclined to lug out, before failing to let down in the straight. A post vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well . Settled Down Two Wide 7th 5 Lengths @ 800m. Ridden Along 5 deep into Straight . Ridden Along Moved Up as a threat 200m. Kept Going Soundly Not Knocked About late Clear 3rd # good & Sound
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 100m was hampered by another runner, which shifted out. Jockey  was reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out fully to the finish.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well. Rolled fwd & shared lead on inside early . Back 1/2L to 2nd on inside midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide @ 500m. Pressured Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Weakened Six Wide in last 200m. # On-pace/weakened.
